title: Sophisticated Storage
description: Upgrade a chest or barrel in place, make more room for bulk materials and control what your factory puts in or takes out.
materials: A placed vanilla Chest or Barrel
One Lever and four Sticks for a Basic Tier Upgrade
For bulk storage, a Stack Upgrade Tier 1
For automated sorting, a Filter Upgrade and a free upgrade slot
For the second slot on a single Chest or Barrel, one Lever and eight Iron Ingots

steps.title: Upgrade the container where it stands
steps.text: Craft a Basic Tier Upgrade with a Lever surrounded by four Sticks in a cross. Close the container, hold the upgrade and right-click a placed vanilla chest or barrel. It keeps its contents and gains one upgrade slot. A double chest uses two tier upgrades.

steps.title: Make bulk materials fit
steps.text: Craft a Stack Upgrade Tier 1 with eight logs around an Upgrade Base, then put it in the container's upgrade slot. A cobblestone stack can now hold 128 items per slot. Shift-click to take one normal stack. Ctrl + Shift + left-click takes as much from that slot as your inventory can hold.

figure.alt: A Basic Tier Upgrade turns a vanilla barrel into a wood barrel with one upgrade slot. The iron tier has 54 inventory slots and two upgrade slots. A Stack Upgrade doubles the cobblestone limit per slot from 64 to 128.
figure.caption: Tier upgrades add container slots. A Stack Upgrade lets each slot hold more of the same item.

steps.title: Filter a hopper or pipe
steps.text: Use a Basic to Iron Tier Upgrade on the placed container to get a second upgrade slot for the Filter Upgrade. In its filter tab, choose Input and set it to allow a sample item such as Cobblestone. Test the filter with one Cobblestone and one item that should be rejected. Choose Output if you need to filter what a hopper or pipe pulls out.

steps.title: Build a shared drop-off point in Chapter V
steps.text: Craft a Storage Controller with a Calculation Machine and place it against a bank of Sophisticated Storage containers. Right-click the controller with a stack that already has a match in the bank to deposit it. Open the relevant container to take items by hand, or connect a hopper or pipe to a Storage Output for automated extraction.

tips.title: Check the tier and upgrade slots
tips.text: Wood and Copper chests and barrels have one upgrade slot. Iron has two. If a tier upgrade does not apply, check that it starts from the container's current tier and that the container is closed.

tips.title: Clear oversized stacks before removing an upgrade
tips.text: Take out or split oversized stacks before removing a Stack Upgrade. The remaining items need to fit within the lower slot limit.

tips.title: Pack a container before you move it
tips.text: Right-click a filled Sophisticated Storage chest or barrel with Packing Tape. Once it is visibly packed, break it and place it again to move its contents with it.
